accepted_decisions.summary: Found the capital city Washington at the starting location to secure our first foothold and begin production. Deploy the scout to explore the immediate vicinity of the island, and set the archer to fortify the new city to ensure domestic tranquility and defense.

public_events.summary: The horizon of this new world is mine to chart. Lisbon rises today, the first anchor of a global empire.
The dawn of India is upon us. Here, on these shores, we lay the first stone of our eternal legacy.
The sun rises upon our island cradle. We shall harvest the bounty of the sea and work the earth to prepare our people for the great expansion beyond these shores.
The only thing we have to fear is fear itself. Today, we plant the seeds of a new American era on these shores.
Let us survey the land and sea; expansion is the lifeblood of our future. Scouts, move out!
The only thing we have to fear is the fog of war itself. Today, we plant our flag and build a new world from these shores. Washington rises!
The land is but a stepping stone! We shall tap the bounty of the ocean first, for the wealth of Portugal has always been found upon the waves.
The worker toils so that the empire may feast. While the warrior scouts the unknown, we shall tame the land and the tides.
The site is chosen. Let Washington rise from the earth, a beacon of democracy in these uncharted waters! We march toward a destiny defined by our own resolve.

thought_memory.strategy:
Alright, the user wants me to channel FDR in this round of Civ IV. Got it. I'm starting with a Settler and a couple of military units – an Archer and a Scout – at coordinates (27, 30). This is on an Archipelago map, which means land is going to be a precious commodity. And from the looks of this initial image, I'm starting on a rather small island. That's my immediate focus – survival!

My first move is crystal clear: **Found the capital city right here at (27, 30) immediately**. No dawdling, no exploring first. Securing that single tile is paramount. This initial settlement is going to be the bedrock of my civilization, its prosperity and, ultimately, its survival. Once I have the city, then I can see what resources are available on the island, and then start making intelligent choices.
